g.text: M3b native worker, callback context and ownership
Start copies pinned input before returning.
Wait joins the worker and all callbacks.
Then unregister token, free context and release extra reference.
Late progress after stop is suppressed; in-flight callback must return.
Host awaits Engine disposal, then adapter disposal.
Stop failure: join, fault engine, release safely.
Wait failure: retain handle reference + GCHandle until process exit.
Faulted engine rejects all new runs.
